title: Heart Evangelista tops NYFW celebrity voices list, beats Paris Hilton, Jung Hae-In

blocks.text: Heart Evangelista emerged as the top celebrity voice at New York Fashion Week (NYFW) for Spring/Summer 2027, generating $7.6 million in Media Impact Value (MIV). According to fashion analytics firm Launchmetrics, Evangelista topped the celebrity ranking ahead of American personality Paris Hilton, who generated $2.5 million in MIV, and South Korean actor Jung Hae-In, with $2.3 million.
